parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: This is the seat of a folding chair, typically made of steel or metal sheet for durability and support.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main sitting surface for the user, supporting body weight and comfort during use.
parts.Movement_description: It can fold upward or downward along the hinge mechanism to allow the chair to collapse for storage.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the folding chair, made of tubular steel for structural strength.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the seat and backrest, providing stability and allowing the folding mechanism to function.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots at the joints to fold or unfold the chair, maintaining rigidity when locked in the open position.
